## Speed and Performance

### NordVPN's Speed Capabilities

NordVPN has invested heavily in its server infrastructure over the past few years. By 2026, the service boasts over 6,400 servers across 111 countries, and the introduction of its proprietary NordLynx protocol (built on WireGuard) has made a noticeable difference in connection speeds. In independent speed tests conducted throughout 2025 and early 2026, NordVPN consistently delivered download speeds that retained 90–94% of the base connection on nearby servers. For long-distance connections — say, connecting from the U.S. to a server in Australia — speeds remained impressively stable, rarely dropping below 70% of the original bandwidth.

One area where NordVPN really shines is consistency. Whether you're connecting during peak hours or late at night, the performance doesn't fluctuate wildly. This makes it a strong choice for users who need reliable speeds for streaming, gaming, or large file transfers.

### ExpressVPN's Speed Capabilities

ExpressVPN has always been known for speed, and in 2026, that reputation holds up. With servers in 105 countries and its proprietary Lightway protocol, ExpressVPN delivers blazing-fast connections that often edge out the competition in head-to-head tests. In recent benchmarks, ExpressVPN maintained 92–96% of base speeds on nearby servers and handled long-distance connections with minimal latency.

The Lightway protocol is particularly impressive because it uses fewer lines of code than traditional VPN protocols, which translates to faster connection times and lower battery consumption on mobile devices. If raw speed is your top priority, ExpressVPN has a slight edge in most scenarios.

### The Verdict on Speed

Both VPNs are fast — there's no denying that. ExpressVPN tends to have a marginal advantage in raw speed tests, but NordVPN offers more consistent performance across a wider range of server locations. For most everyday users, the difference will be negligible. If you're a power user who needs the absolute fastest connection possible, ExpressVPN might be the better pick.

## Security and Privacy

### NordVPN's Security Features

NordVPN is based in Panama, which is excellent news for privacy-conscious users. Panama has no mandatory data retention laws and sits outside the jurisdiction of the Five Eyes, Nine Eyes, and Fourteen Eyes intelligence-sharing alliances. This means NordVPN isn't legally required to store or hand over user data.

On the technical side, NordVPN offers AES-256 encryption, a kill switch (both app-level and system-level), DNS and IPv6 leak protection, and double VPN (which routes your traffic through two servers for extra security). The service also includes Threat Protection, a feature that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious websites before they even reach your device. In 2026, NordVPN has also rolled out post-quantum encryption on select servers, preparing for the future of cybersecurity.

NordVPN has undergone multiple independent audits by firms like Deloitte and PwC, all of which have confirmed its no-logs policy. This track record of transparency is a significant trust factor.

### ExpressVPN's Security Features

ExpressVPN is headquartered in the British Virgin Islands, another privacy-friendly jurisdiction with no data retention laws. Like NordVPN, it operates outside the reach of major intelligence alliances.

ExpressVPN uses AES-256 encryption, a reliable kill switch (called Network Lock), and its own Lightway protocol, which has been open-source since 2023. The company also uses TrustedServer technology, meaning every server runs on RAM only — no hard drives involved. Every time a server reboots, all data is wiped clean. This is one of the most elegant security approaches in the VPN industry.

ExpressVPN has also completed independent audits, including a comprehensive review by Cure53 and PwC, verifying its no-logs claims. In 2026, the company introduced its own post-quantum encryption layer, matching NordVPN's forward-looking security measures.

### The Verdict on Security

This is essentially a tie. Both NordVPN and ExpressVPN offer top-tier security, operate in privacy-friendly jurisdictions, maintain verified no-logs policies, and have embraced post-quantum encryption. You can't go wrong with either option from a security standpoint.

## Streaming and Unblocking

### NordVPN for Streaming

NordVPN has become one of the most reliable VPNs for streaming in 2026. It consistently unblocks Netflix (including U.S., U.K., Japan, and other regional libraries), Disney+, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, BBC iPlayer, and HBO Max. The service uses obfuscated servers and smart DNS features to bypass even the most aggressive VPN detection systems.

One standout feature is NordVPN's SmartPlay technology, which automatically optimizes your connection for streaming without requiring any manual configuration. It just works — you connect, open your streaming app, and enjoy buffer-free content.

### ExpressVPN for Streaming

ExpressVPN has long been considered the gold standard for streaming, and in 2026, it continues to deliver. It reliably unblocks all major streaming platforms, including Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, BBC iPlayer, Amazon Prime Video, and more. ExpressVPN's MediaStreamer DNS feature is particularly useful for devices that don't natively support VPN apps, like certain smart TVs and gaming consoles.

ExpressVPN's ability to bypass geo-restrictions is remarkably consistent. Even when streaming platforms update their VPN detection methods, ExpressVPN typically adapts within hours, not days.

### The Verdict on Streaming

Both services are excellent for streaming, but ExpressVPN has a slight edge in reliability and speed of adaptation when platforms update their blocking mechanisms. NordVPN is a very close second and offers more simultaneous connections, which is great for households with multiple streamers.
